narrative.overview: Imperial Securities reads as a regulated institution that happens to be digital — not a startup trading app dressed in bank cosplay. The visual system is Committed on blue and green: institutional blue carries navigation, heroes, and trust; growth green carries primary conversion (Open Account). Surfaces stay clean white or cool gray-lt with tinted neutrals toward hue 255–265, never warm cream defaults.
keyCharacteristics: DM Sans for headings and body
Green gradient primary CTA; blue outline secondary
Dark hero bands for page intros

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue speaks institution; green speaks action. Do not introduce purple, indigo, cyan, or orange as section accents.

rules.name: The Dark-Surface Text Rule
rules.body: On brand-dark or blue gradient backgrounds, body copy uses oklch(0.99 0 0 / 0.85) minimum — never text-white/55 for readable paragraphs.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Budget Rule
rules.body: Tiny uppercase tracked labels are legacy. New work: one kicker per page maximum.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest have no shadow. Elevation responds to hover, sticky headers, or primary CTAs only.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: backdrop-blur prohibited on content cards except mobile sticky nav scrim.

dos: Do use OKLCH brand tokens from src/styles.css for all new color work.
Do use DM Sans for both headings and body copy.
Do lead regulated pages with license context in hero or first screen.
Do keep section padding at py-12 md:py-16 and container at max-w-[1280px] px-4 sm:px-6.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on all new animations.
Do use green gradient for the single primary CTA per viewport section.
donts: Don't use generic AI template patterns: Inter/system fonts, purple-to-blue gradients, identical icon+card grids, gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, hero-metric stat blocks.
Don't use startup SaaS tells: bounce/elastic easing, excessive motion, pill badges everywhere, nested cards, gray muted text on tinted backgrounds below 4.5:1 contrast.
Don't use flashy fintech/crypto aesthetics: neon accents, terminal-dark UI, gamified elements.
Don't ship dated legacy broker UI: cluttered tables, tiny type, touch targets under 44px.
Don't add border-left or border-right greater than 1px as colored accents on callouts.
Don't put uppercase tracked eyebrows on every section.
Don't use numbered 01/02/03 markers unless the section is a genuine ordered sequence.
Don't introduce purple, indigo, or cyan accent colors outside the brand token set.
